item.title: Justin Rose sets scoring record and becomes first wire-to-wire winner at Torrey Pines since 1955
item.description: Justin Rose is the first wire-to-wire winner at Torrey Pines in 71 years. Rose finished with a 70 to break the tournament scoring record last set by Tiger Woods in 1999. He finished at 23-under 265. The Farmers Insurance Open has some of the best weather ever. What it didn't have was drama. Rose started with a six-shot lead and never let anyone get any closer, winning by seven. Tommy Bolt in 1955 was the last player to win this tournament from start to finish without ties. item.title: Kennedy Center to close for 2 years for renovations in July, Trump says, after performers’ backlash
item.description: President Donald Trump says he will move to close Washington’s Kennedy Center performing arts venue for two years starting in July for construction. Trump’s announcement on social media Sunday night follows a wave of cancellations by artists since Trump ousted the previous leadership and added his name to the building. item.title: Groundhog Day puts Punxsutawney Phil’s forecast about winter’s length in the spotlight
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil's handlers will be announcing if the weather-predicting groundhog sees his shadow. If he's deemed to have seen his shadow around daybreak Monday, it'll mean six more weeks of winter. If not, an early spring is expected. Tens of thousands are descending on Gobbler's Knob in western Pennsylvania for the annual ritual.
